Messages.Author: nys...@cs.com
Messages.Body:
Baseball Bat (new equipment/weapon) says "Do not replace until the end
of this action".

Suppose you play the card while no action is pending. Do you
immediately replace the card? Or never replace the card?

Messages.Author: brandons...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:


How would you play this card that isn't as part of an action?

Brandon

Messages.Author: nys...@cs.com
Messages.Body:


Pier 13, Port of Baltimore

Concealed Weapon (or Disguised Weapon), after entering combat via
Brujah Frenzy

Angel of Berlin

There may be others.

Messages.Author: Shockwave
Messages.Body:


Then surely you'd replace at the end of the action currently being
resolved. :) There's an action underway, it's just not one to equip
the weapon.

So in that case, you Concealed/Disguised mid combat, you redraw after
action resolution, including this combat.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3e6b26db-dbe8-45ba...@j22g2000hsf.googlegroup

s.com>, nys...@cs.com writes:
>Normally, whenever there is a combat, there is an action being
>resolved. The example I cited was an exception.

Brujah Frenzy is not an exception to combat occuring during an action.

The action is unsuccessful, and there's a combat in the action. Just
like any action that's been blocked (unsuccessful, action still going
on, combat happening).
